U.note: Flat top-down 32x32 painter with 8 colors and save; works but looks like a plain pixel grid, empty start, and the mobile grid lines render unevenly.

V.note: Polished dark 32x32 grid with counts and shortcuts but only four kinds, empty dark canvas and the desktop footer is cut off at 800px.

W.note: Isometric 3D 32x32 voxel world with generated terrain, 9 block types, place/erase/undo, and a layout that fits desktop and phone.

X.note: Top-down column stacking with a height cap of 6 and clear hints is sound but visually bare with only three block types.

Y.note: Clean sidebar with 8 blocks, autosave and block count, but it is a flat empty grid with no sense of building.

Z.note: Textured side-view 32x32 sandbox with pre-built terrain, tree, 10 tools and good mobile layout; reads as a Minecraft-like builder.
